plan:
-  Select a 5-inch carbon fiber frame kit (e.g., X-type or H-type) for durability and rigidity.
-  Integrate an F4/F7 flight controller (FC) with an integrated OSD and PDB, a 4-in-1 ESC (30-60A), and a compatible receiver (e.g., Crossfire, ELRS, FrSky).
-  Mount four high-KV (1700-2400KV) brushless motors with matching 5-inch propellers and secure with appropriate M5 prop nuts.
-  Install an FPV camera (e.g., Caddx Ratel, Runcam Phoenix) and a video transmitter (VTX) with an antenna, ensuring clear video feed.
-  Power the system with a 4S or 6S LiPo battery (1300-1500mAh) and include a low-ESR capacitor for clean power delivery.
-  Design custom 3D-printed parts for camera mounts, antenna mounts, and potentially a LiPo skid plate.

originalPrompt: Please help with the design and build of a 5" racing FPV drone. Give comprehensive instructions for design and build procedure. As much as possible, give good-looking CAD schematics of the assembly procedure and major parts.

subSteps.title: Prepare FC and ESC for Soldering
Solder Main Power and Capacitor to ESC
Solder Crossfire Receiver to Flight Controller
Solder FPV Camera to Flight Controller
Connect Video Transmitter (VTX) to Flight Controller and Camera
Perform Continuity Checks on All Power Lines
Bind Crossfire Receiver and Configure Channels
Test FPV Video Feed and VTX Settings
Calibrate Accelerometer and Perform Failsafe Setup
Install FPV Camera and VTX/RX Antennas with 3D Printed Mounts
Attach LiPo Skid Plate and Battery Straps

projectDescription: A 5-inch racing FPV drone built on an X-type carbon fiber frame. It uses a 6S LiPo battery to power four brushless motors and 5-inch propellers, controlled by a flight controller and 4-in-1 ESC. An FPV camera, video transmitter, and Crossfire receiver provide real-time video and reliable control for high-speed flight.

tools: Zip ties and electrical tape (for cable management)
assumptions: Familiarity with FPV drone components and assembly practices
Access to a computer for firmware flashing and configuration (Betaflight/BLHeli_32 Configurator)
Understanding of LiPo battery safety and handling
